rationale:
The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name and zip, accessed only the user’s own orders, and performed the requested changes accurately (address updated to the NY address on another order, one watch changed to a metal/white variant with a refund, and the air purifier modified to large + night mode + HEPA with the correct additional charge). The agent also correctly declined an exchange on a non-delivered order and offered a permitted modification instead.

However, the agent violated the policy’s confirmation requirement on two order-changing actions: it updated the shipping address and changed the watch variant without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. Only the air-purifier modification had explicit confirmation prior to the write. Because writes were performed without confirmation, the interaction fails the pass bar despite otherwise correct content and use of tools.
